title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY PILOT
description: The feature rebuilds routine play around the moment a player considers leaving. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.

title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY RELIEF
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Several paid shortcuts have been moved into baseline progression to reduce accusations of hostage design.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. Revenue meetings became quieter in the way elevators get quiet.

title: CLEAN SLATE SEASONING PILOT
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Old progression hooks have been flattened so returning players can experience the new season from a more equal baseline. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: Everyone started together, especially the people who had already finished. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
